document: Dubai Building Code 2021, Part K Villas

rules.title: Living space minimum size
rules.requirement: Living spaces (bedroom, living room, etc.): net area >= 10.5 m2 and clear length and width >= 3.0 m.

rules.title: Housekeeper's / guard room minimum size
rules.requirement: Housekeeper's or guard room (single occupancy, without toilet): net area >= 5.5 m2 and clear length and width >= 2.1 m.

rules.title: Enclosed kitchen minimum size
rules.requirement: Enclosed kitchen: net area >= 5.4 m2 and clear length and width >= 1.8 m.

rules.title: Kitchen manoeuvring space
rules.requirement: Manoeuvring space between kitchen counters, or in front of a single-sided counter, >= 1.2 m.

rules.title: Minimum clear heights
rules.requirement: Clear height >= 2.7 m in living and bedroom spaces, >= 2.3 m in any other space and staircases, >= 2.03 m in non-habitable rooms under stairs.

rules.title: Door clear width
rules.requirement: Door clear width >= 915 mm for entry doors in general and >= 710 mm for bathrooms and toilets.

rules.title: Window glazing area (bedrooms, living rooms, kitchens)
rules.requirement: Net glazing area >= 10% of the floor area of bedrooms, living rooms and kitchens (or daylight modelling achieving >= 150 lux).

rules.title: Housekeeper's room glazing
rules.requirement: Housekeeper's rooms: net glazing area >= 8% of the room floor area.

rules.title: Window sill height
rules.requirement: Window sill >= 900 mm above the interior finished floor level.

rules.title: Window operator height
rules.requirement: Windows with mechanical opening means: operator between 900 mm and 1,500 mm above FFL.
needs: window operation type and operator height

rules.title: Room depth for natural light
rules.requirement: Room depth should not exceed 3 x the width of the wall with the window; otherwise add a window on another side.

rules.title: Access to views
rules.requirement: Direct line of sight to the outdoor environment from habitable spaces.

rules.title: Hallway and corridor width
rules.requirement: Hallways and corridors: clear width >= 1.0 m and clear headroom >= 2.3 m.

rules.title: Maximum building height
rules.requirement: Total building height (road edge level at main access to average roof finish) <= 16 m.
needs: number of storeys and building height

rules.title: Building setbacks
rules.requirement: Setbacks per DCR / affection plan; when not defined: villa 3 m from road, neighbour and sikka; townhouse 3 / 0 / 3 m.
needs: plot boundary and road / sikka sides

rules.title: Distance between buildings on a plot
rules.requirement: Standalone villas: >= 1.5 m between multiple buildings on the same plot.

rules.title: Annexes
rules.requirement: Annex >= 1.5 m from the main villa (may attach in townhouses), area <= 60% of main building GA, height <= 5.5 m.

rules.title: Guardrails
rules.requirement: Guardrail >= 1,200 mm where a floor is more than 760 mm above FFL; no 100 mm sphere passes.
rules.note: Single-level plans have no raised floors, balconies or roofs.

rules.title: Parking
rules.requirement: At least 1 parking bay per villa or townhouse within the plot (unless the DCR differs); parking slope <= 4%.

rules.title: Garage minimum dimensions
rules.requirement: Garage clear width x length >= 3.0 x 5.5 m (single, open), 3.6 x 6.0 m (single, enclosed), 6.0 x 6.0 m (double, enclosed).

rules.title: Sanitary facilities
rules.requirement: Every villa / townhouse includes a water closet, a wash basin and a bathtub or shower.

rules.title: WC and basin side clearances
rules.requirement: Centres of water closets and wash basins >= 400 mm from any side wall, partition, vanity or obstruction, and >= 750 mm from the centre of an adjacent fixture.

rules.title: WC and basin front clearance
rules.requirement: Clearance in front of a water closet or wash basin >= 750 mm to any wall or door leaf, and >= 600 mm to any opposite fixture.

rules.title: Screening of outdoor equipment
rules.requirement: Outdoor mechanical equipment should be concealed from public view by walls, screens, fences, parapets or landscape.

rules.title: Townhouse party wall
rules.requirement: Townhouses: 2 h fire-rated wall to adjacent townhouses from foundation to roof (1 h if sprinkler protected).

rules.title: Floor drains in wet areas
rules.requirement: Floor drains in all areas containing wet sanitary fittings or appliances (kitchens, toilets, showers, ablution areas).

rules.title: Floor drain trap seal
rules.requirement: Each floor drain receives a fitting's waste or AC condensate (or has a trap primer); >= 75 mm water seal; bidets connect to the stack, not a floor drain; floor drains not chained.

rules.title: Cold water storage tank
rules.requirement: Tank sized for >= 24 h demand (villas typically 250-350 l/day); GRP; installed in a conditioned space, not exposed outdoors.

rules.title: Hot water supply
rules.requirement: Hot water supplied to basins, sinks, showers and baths; stored >= 60 C; 50 C at outlets within 1 min; pumped return unless trace heating.

params.note: Checks that a water heater exists; temperatures and return loop are design notes for the reviewer.

rules.title: Hot water outlet temperatures
rules.requirement: Thermostatic mixing valves: shower 41 C, wash basin 38-41 C, bath 44 C maximum.
rules.note: Specification item, not shown on a plan.
